name: online_shuangpin
note: Step 4 is not the reference's output: the reference appended every shorter shuangpin prefix group whole (shuangpin/shuangpin_dictionary.cpp:214-229) and, for a single trailing helpcode, appended the whole-input series and then the unmatched rows after the matched ones (SD:370-372), so a word several of those lists answer was listed once per list. Showing the same candidate more than once is a bug (decision 2026-09-30): the port keeps each word at its first seat and drops the later copies, and the step was rewritten to that output.
